about_the_game:
Voidblade: Shadows of the Realm

Voidblade: Shadows of the Realm is a 2D platformer with a dark Halloween theme, delivering a chilling and challenging experience for fans of the genre.

You play as a cursed warrior wielding the legendary Voidblade, tasked with traversing sinister landscapes filled with supernatural creatures, deadly traps, and dangerous obstacles. There are no puzzles to slow down your journey — only action, exploration, and sharp reflexes.

Prepare to leap over rivers of lava, dodge treacherous spikes, and battle eerie enemies such as living pumpkins, ghosts, and bats, all within a world inspired by haunting Halloween tales.

An exclusive soundtrack sets the tone with eerie melodies, immersing you in the shadowy realm you must conquer.

🔹 Key Features

🎃 Halloween Atmosphere – dark levels, enemies, and sound effects create a spooky, immersive setting.

⚔️ Pure Action – no puzzles, just skill-based combat, fast-paced platforming, and exploration.

🔥 Deadly Hazards – avoid lava, spikes, and lethal traps as you fight for survival.

👾 Themed Enemies – face supernatural creatures inspired by folklore and Halloween legends.

🎶 Original Soundtrack – haunting music crafted to match every moment of your journey.

🕹️ Challenging Platforming – levels designed to test reflexes, timing, and precision.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon HD 7850 (2 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 2–4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Drivers: Mesa 20.0+ or NVIDIA 450+
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0 (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 ou AMD Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560 (4 GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 4–6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Drivers: Mesa 22.0+ ou NVIDIA 515+
